title: Tricky Trolls
description: This Mod Adds 2 Trolls To minecraft and custom armor and blocks all obtainable in survival!
body:
A long time ago when minecraft didn't add Trolls

Trolls came out of the ground to attack every cow in sight and everything they stumbled apon..
All for food, to survive.

Same for cave trolls.
Only they eat a bunch of rocks.


**This Mod Adds:**
Trolls and Cave Trolls + Secret Stuff wich are:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Troll Skull (wearable)
Dropped from a troll

Cave Troll Scute
dropped from a Cave Troll

cave scute block
crafted with 6 cave troll scutes
acts like obsidian but faster breakable
and easier to farm

</details>
